deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding for Sellout users
Independent third-party smart-contract audit with published remediation
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and governance reporting
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator via TRSC/PSSC framework
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and includes on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout has invested over $130,000 of its own capital into Phase 1.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee, over 8 months.
Phase 2 is planned to deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent third-party audit, and launch amplification.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism of 25% of fees until reimbursement, then 5% permanently.
The proposal projects 12-month launch targets of 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6,000,000+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move over $6 million through Cardano in Year 1.
Anvil claims a track record of 250+ Cardano projects delivered, 456,000+ assets minted, 50,000,000+ ADA staked through its infrastructure, and 267,000+ on-chain transactions.
The proposal states that all on-chain metrics will be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public M5 dashboard, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.
Intersect is described as budget administrator by prior agreement, using the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with independent oversight and public on-chain dashboarding.

summary: The proposal seeks 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing marketplace, with milestone-gated disbursement, Intersect administration, claimed Sellout/Anvil adoption foundations, projected on-chain usage, and a contractual revenue-share repayment commitment.
